recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the applied FHIR-22531 decision without restoring removed profiles or broadening the change into unrelated StructureDefinition fixtures; handle any modernization of those generic fixtures under a separate tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-22531 was Applied with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked about multiple lipid DiagnosticReport/Observation profiles sharing the title Example Lipid Profile; the OO decision was to remove those example profiles from the DiagnosticReport profile page, link users to the lipid panel DiagnosticReport example instead, and name the example appropriately.
initial_application: Prior FHIR-22531 commits 61baf46c8aa70c2f596bc17419ace51bb9608ed4 and 3128420e7110d810fc544997b2ebead60052917d removed the DiagnosticReport lipid profile/IG source files, emptied list-DiagnosticReport-packs.xml, and repointed links to diagnosticreport-example-lipid-panel.html. The active lipid panel example still carried meta.profile http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/lipids-diagnostic-report and profiling-examples.html still displayed Example Lipid Profile for that link.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps DiagnosticReport in the active resource list, list-DiagnosticReport-examples.xml actively lists DiagnosticReport/lipid-panel-example, and list-DiagnosticReport-packs.xml now has no profile pack entries. OO minutes from 2025-01-14 explicitly say these were example profiles rather than intended core profiles and that the example wording should read Lipid Panel Report. Remaining Example Lipid Profile occurrences under source/structuredefinition are generic StructureDefinition examples or invariant-test fixtures outside the DiagnosticReport profile listing and were not changed.
reconciliation: Removed the stale meta.profile declaration and matching comment from source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-example-lipid-panel.xml, and changed the profiling-examples.html link text from Example Lipid Profile to Lipid Panel Report while preserving the intended link to diagnosticreport-example-lipid-panel.html.
source_changes: source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-example-lipid-panel.xml: removed the stale meta.profile for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/lipids-diagnostic-report and updated the obsolete profile-reference comment.
source/profiling-examples.html: changed the lipid panel link label from Example Lipid Profile to Lipid Panel Report.
